title: decisions-persist replaces a session's decisions with deleteMany then insertMany: a clean re-extraction discards human-set status (verified/needs-review) and a failed insertMany after the delete loses the rows
evidence: Read of source: on a non-degraded run it calls deleteMany({evidence.sessionId}) then insertMany of fresh status=proposed docs, not atomic and not status-aware. schema/decisions.schema.json allows status verified|needs-review. Mirrors the claims write in session.ts. session.ts catches a thrown insertMany and reports decisions.degraded, but rows already deleted are not restored. Nothing in this repo sets a decision to verified yet, so no data is lost today.
fix_direction: Before a decisions review flow exists: delete only status=proposed rows for the session, or upsert by (sessionId, evidence turn ids) so verified rows survive. File-dont-fix until a verified-status writer exists.
verification_note: already fixed on master in decisions-persist.ts; replayed 2/2 by w27-decisionskeep
